passages.text:
Hi Vera,
As promised, please find attached Internews' pitch for an RDMA regional program that YouTube can contribute funding
towards. I'm not sure that RDMA has reviewed it yet, so please let's hold off conversations with them until they officially
share, but I understand that time is a concern here and I wanted you to take a look. I will try to schedule a call with them
next week -- finding a time to talk between Belgrade and Bangkok is not too difficult.
Separately, Internews asked me about how they might be able to be involved in YT's Trusted Flagger program, if that
remains an area that YT is interested in collaborating on. Internews has worked with Meta's "Trusted Partner" program
and is even conducting a comprehensive review of the program, aiming to survey around 10% of Meta's partners globally
that they hope to produce later this year as a public document.
Best,
Josh

Fwd: Potential synergies with YouTube
[contact omitted] Joshua Machleder Friday, August 5, 2022 at 5:59:18 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
Hi Vera,
As promised, please find attached Internews' pitch for an RDMA regional program that YouTube can contribute funding
towards. I'm not sure that RDMA has reviewed it yet, so please let's hold off conversations with them until they officially
share, but I understand that time is a concern here and I wanted you to take a look. I will try to schedule a call with them
next week -- finding a time to talk between Belgrade and Bangkok is not too difficult.
Separately, Internews asked me about how they might be able to be involved in YT's Trusted Flagger program, if that
remains an area that YT is interested in collaborating on. Internews has worked with Meta's "Trusted Partner" program
and is even conducting a comprehensive review of the program, aiming to survey around 10% of Meta's partners globally
that they hope to produce later this year as a public document.
Best,
Josh
